nodes.label: Intraday monitor contract
nodes.rationale: An independent monitor preserves the daily screener, supports up to 50 configured symbols and emits technical setup alerts without order endpoints. Provider entitlement is separate: a symbol-limit rejection is terminal and never silently truncates the list or changes feeds.

nodes.label: Alpaca seed and WebSocket transport
nodes.rationale: Fixed-host REST seeds precede a verified TLS WebSocket session. Live status requires authentication and subscription acknowledgments. Transport is bounded and cancellable; the root service owns reseeding/reconnect backoff, and optional float failures do not fail prices.

nodes.label: Monitor lifecycle and refresh isolation
nodes.rationale: Explicit Start controls streaming. Stop invalidates old-generation callbacks and pending refresh work. Background refresh preserves newer stream values and confirmation state. SSE is throttled, compact snapshots omit chart history, and configured-source alert filtering occurs before the latest-100 limit.

nodes.label: Frozen alert evidence schema v1
nodes.rationale: Alerts preserve config, snapshot, session, reference minute and original model assumptions. Planning quotes retain provider event time and actual receipt time; rendering cannot refresh old evidence. Outcomes reconcile only matching source/feed/session, and legacy evidence stays unavailable.

hyperedges.label: Original alert evidence, frozen planning and separate observed outcomes
